name: Karma
source:
70 years have passed——

it is the time for you to payback.

Inspired by the sadness and sorrow in Hong Kong through June and July——

a story about a dystopia.

[From [url=https://herstory.itch.io/karma]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
70年过去了——

现在是你回报的时候了。

受到六七月香港的悲伤与悲伤的启发——

一个关于反乌托邦的故事。

[来自[url=https://herstory.itch.io/karma]Itch.io[/url]]
